name: Mercenary for Hire!: a Mercenary can attack back a ruleset player who walked out of a capital in view
contract: A Mercenary sees a same-faction High-Risk or War Mode player as friendly unless that player's values carry the free-for-all PvP flag, which the server patches in only for Mercenary viewers and only outside no-PvP areas. Capitals mark players as being in a no-PvP area without changing their own fields, so leaving a capital must resend the patched field to watching Mercenaries; otherwise the other player can attack the Mercenary while the Mercenary's client refuses to attack back. Two Orcs pick High-Risk at the Orgrimmar gate and one takes up Mercenary for Hire!. The other steps out into Durotar while both stay in view: the Mercenary is sent the free-for-all PvP flag for it, both can attack each other once the Mercenary follows, and stepping back into Orgrimmar sends the flag off again.
